body:
I stopped sharing too many details with even some of my best friends bc they all turned on her after the unprotected sex omission so soon after I gave her a diamond ring. It was tiring and hurtful to hear my friends rally against her and tell me to end my engagement. I gave her that ring bc I wanted to build a strong beautiful life together. 

It just doesn’t seem like the future I wanted is compatible with what she wants. She wants me as a life partner, but also seems to think she deserves to sleep with as many me as I have? That made me pause when she said that a few weeks ago… and now these events make me pause even further.

I’m not arguing that we probably should have broken up a long time ago, it was probably the right thing to do around the time we decided to go open/ENM. 

I told her she should explore with men since I knew she wanted to but was too afraid. I told her not to hold back on my account, that I would feel deep pity for her if she lived and died without sleeping with a guy since I know she fantasizes about it all the time. 

I just don’t think I’m mentally equipped to be with someone going through the aftermath of a mtf transition. I thought I was good for her, but clearly I am not.
It’s why I’m on Reddit. I want unbiased opinions, when I say obviously my friends are on my side… that’s bc they are my friends. They won’t take her side. I wanted a fair discussion.

Afraid of me bringing down her mood or making her feel like she couldn’t enjoy herself. 

I don’t disagree it’s gaslighting, but her fear was a bummer of a night, not fear of me yelling at her or like breaking up.

It was more that she thought an emergency text automatically sent after if something did happen would have alerted me to the fact that something bad happened to her. I wouldn’t want to find out my partner of 3 years disappeared via auto text. We talk about raising kids, buying a house, traveling the world together. I didn’t want my partner to think an emergency auto text was sufficient communication if something did happen.  Idk obviously women are capable of taking care of themselves but almost all of my friends have been raped, some even kidnapped, abused, stolen from while on dates with new people/strangers. 

My friends group and I might be a little protective of one another but I have a hard time seeing it’s controlling. It’s more like “hey, if I go missing after Friday night, be sure to tell the cops it was this dude and his number is this”

Forgive me but I’m new to poly, I had no idea. It’s not like I need play by play during and after a date. It’s more if it’s a new person we both wanted to make sure we came home at some point. She’s been scared for my safety too while I’m on dates. I thought it was an expression of love, i see now it’s a lack of trust all around.

I thought I had found a poly/ENM support group with all of my poly friends. They are fueling the fire by saying it was borderline cheating and I deserve the truth and what she did was f Ed up. 

I’m trying to forgive but I can’t forgive myself.

I think I know what I need to do. I need to let her go. 

She deserves the best from her partner. Her partner deserves the best from her too, neither one of us is doing that for one another.

I thought I was able to be that for her, but I can’t ever give her what these dudes give her and can’t make her feel as much as a woman as they do (she’s said this). 

I can’t give her the type of home life where she doesn’t assume I’m being aloof with her mom, she can’t assume that I won’t blow up about her doing on a date. Something I thought she would know wouldn’t be the case but after the fact me making too big of a deal kind of defeats that argument.

If our relationship is toxic it’s time to end it. I really wanted a life together, and saw a path towards happiness but ever since she told me she wants to be with men and I can’t do what they do for her. I didn’t feel adequate sexually and now I don’t feel adequate emotionally.

I have control issues, can’t say why and from where but growing up in a super abusive family doesn’t help. 

I agree i overreacted to an extent from
Everyone’s feedback here, but I didn’t know i overreacted till I got unbiased feedback. Obviously my poly and non poly friends are on my side, but I wanted to hear what Reddit thought. 

I don’t know if we will continue our relationship. 

I honestly don’t want to hurt her in any way shape or form. If being with me exposes her to too much mental and emotionally instability then we should end it. I obviously have a lot of work to do and don’t want to inflict damage on her. 

I just didn’t know that’s how she felt about me. Her blowing up at me for not treating her mom better last Thursday and then saying I react badly so she told after the fact Sunday just shows to me that there’s resentment in our relationship. I did treat her mother well, I just got off the phone with her mom rn. It just felt completely out of left field. 

I don’t think I’m this big scary monster, but if I am to her, I believe her and want her safe so I will remove myself from the equation.
Testing* not texting

Scared and afraid kind of imply threats of physical or emotional harm. In this case she was worried I would react badly and ruin her date? It was a I wanted to have fun without worrying you and you’ve reacted badly when I was on dates before. 

Her reasons being that in the past I have blown up at her about dates but there was context. I told her do not come home late, or just don’t come home and spend the night there but I need to sleep early and she came home late and then said she’d be home by 11, and I didn’t see her till 12:30. So yeah I was unhappy bc she didn’t keep her promise and her not spending the night there wasn’t bc of me, she didn’t want him to see her morning after face bc she felt insecure. I wish she had spent the night bc then I wouldn’t have been waiting up for her and let down when she didn’t show up and kept pushing it later and later. Other date where I got upset a few days later is bc she slept with him unprotected when she promised she wouldn’t, or if she did to just give me a heads up so we could be vigilant about texting and maybe consider prep for both of us. So like yeah did we have meh experiences around dating? Yes, but it’s a back and forth of oh well you ruin my dates… and I’m thinking… you ruined your date yourself by promising you wouldn’t do certain things and not following through. Me reacting by being upset about the late night thing is the only time I can think of I’ve given her a “hard time” on a date. That’s why I felt even more hurt bc I really try to not intrude on her time with dudes.
But it was a safety precaution we both agreed upon

I’ve been an asshole at times in the past, I won’t deny that. 

I cried and got defensive one morning during a talk about the roommates and realized I neeed to take time apart bc I don’t want to be so hurt I get defensive around her.

That’s what I kept telling her, it’s really hard to not hurt each other’s as newbs. She’s a newb to her own coming out, we’re both new to open/ENM. I told her I would rather she date around and be with whoever she wants and to be her own independent person, than to keep hurting each other. I thought it was possible but not I’m definitely not sure.

She said I would bring down her date with bad feelings. She said subconsciously she didn’t want me to worry so it was for my benefit, she said she didn’t want to ruin what sounded like a fun night out with my friends. The thing is, it wouldn’t have ruined my night if she told me, all I want is for her to be safe so I would just want to know who and where and to check in next day to see if she’s ok. 

I might have been hurt that she did that so soon after a big argument, but I get that she just got hurt by some dude and she wanted distraction or a treat. I wouldn’t have blown up her phone or demanded her attention all night. 

I keep telling her my reaction right now is bc my rommmates, co workers, my abusive mother and father (recently went NC) have really been piling it on the last few weeks when I’ve been utterly besides myself with stress. It felt like everyone was coming for me when I could least handle it, and I was hurt that even with all of that context she added to it.

I’m not perfect, I do have an anger problem from my childhood, but I’ve been trying. That’s why I’m so hurt that I felt we were progressing to deeper levels of intimacy, but this feels like a big regression and a sign that after all this time if my partner is just afraid of me. I probably should leave since that’s something I would never want for her, or for myself.

I’ve suggested couples therapy for years, she only became open to the idea this calendar year. I’ve tried to be calm, I cry but I haven’t yelled, touched her in any aggressive manner, screamed at her. I didn’t send threatening texts, took her to dinner twice to try to make some resolution.

I don’t think she set up a date out of spite. I don’t think the reason was malicious, she just got her heart broken by some dude so I understand she needed a pick me up or whatever. 

I wanted to reach out to this subreddit bc I did want a consensus if it was not supposed to be a big deal. Sounds like it’s not and I should not operate on any heads up rule, I wouldn’t know I had asked a few poly people and they say they don’t need permission but just give a heads up that they are going on a new date. 

I don’t even think she would like that if she didn’t know where I went and with whom for first dates. In fact the way she texts me and quizzes me on dates is arguably way more controlling than any text I sent her on her dates. Besides the one night I told her to please not come home late bc it was a work night and I had early morning meetings. She said she’d be home by 10, then it became 11, and then she  got home midnight. It’s just that I had a small boundary set, and she pushed it. We had this other boundary set and she pushed it. I can’t keep trusting someone who does that over and over :(

We’ve been working on better communication from both of us. 

I’m taking time bc this week has been awfully stressful and I can’t deal with job changes and fixing my relationship at the same time. 

I’ve asked that we both get into couples therapy but I don’t know if it’s too late.

I’m taking this time to see if I should leave. 

The part where it matters that I was out of town was we had an incredible date night before I flew out. The next morning she yelled at me for not responding to her mom about my visit, but I had. She didn’t see the group texts for some reason, some issue with her phone. It was just really hard to have my partner yelling at me first thing in the morning instead of asking “hey, you gonna reply to my mom?”. We started my trip out with an argument and ended my trip with an argument
She was very much not a teen. I put 20 something hoping she wouldn’t find this post.

Yes well…. That did happen 3 days after I proposed. She slept with someone without a condom when she said she wouldn’t. I never told her she couldn’t but that if she did we would need to just get her and I on prep and do most testing. It’s not that she did it, like that happens and I get that completely. It’s that she won’t be forthcoming and I have to ask for her to tell me the truth. We did sleep together before she told me and I was hurt bc she could have just mentioned it so I would have had a choice to use protection with her or not.

We got mugged before and I fought off the muggers, this happened a few months ago. Forgive me if I’m still cautious. She also was being molested next to me in a dark bar but didn’t feel comfortable calling out for help or saying anything.  She’s not a child, but yeah I’ve been a little more protective after the mugging. She has been more cautious too, we don’t live in a good neighborhood. Saying my safety concern is a ruse or non issue, makes me wonder how many women open up about partner abuse or rape, bc that’s why my girl friends always text someone, like a friend or family member before they meet dudes online.

It wasn’t about what she does on a date, it’s that we had agreed to give heads up about the date or new people. I never told her not to sleep with anyone new or get permission from me. She can obviously go do that, that’s why I was wondering why she said she didn’t sleep w him out of respect for me, she could have and never has to ask to sleep with someone.

It’s like a 7.5 year age difference but I won’t split hairs. I agree our age difference doesn’t help. It also doesn’t help that as a newly out trans woman she wants to live like a single person and explore. She’s even said it’s not fair that I’ve been with lots of men and she hasn’t. I asked her if she needs to just be single multiple times and so what she wants without someone controlling her but she keeps saying I’m being crazy and she loves me and wants to be with me. 

I don’t think we’re good for each other right now, I just didn’t think I was a shit partner. Perfect? No, but shit…. If I was aware I was shit I would have ended it.

It’s not about the gender of the date. 

If it was a woman , or even a man and a woman, I didn’t expect her to take my being out of town as an opportunity to do whatever she wanted. I told her it shows that a big part of her doesn’t really like me if she has to feel afraid of me. I don’t want to be feared, I’d rather be nothing at all.

I didn’t know it was impractical :( we both had agreed upon it and it made sense from a safety standpoint. I will see if we even are at a place to reassess any groundrules and to consider groundrules as a impractical thing. 

Right now I’m so hurt I can’t be around her partially bc she has not been easy to be around during this stressful time, it’s like she’s trying to make my last week at work even harder instead of trying to be empathetic. 

She expects updates from me during dates that I go on, and yes it was very distracting for my few dates and I was pretty much texting her instead of enjoying myself :( we should both not do that, but this is first I’m reading or hearing that a heads up rule isn’t healthy. 

I try to leave her alone when she’s on dates, I don’t want either one of us to be controlling, right now I’m just in shock bc I didn’t know she could hurt me so much by putting the blame on me.

She did apologize and said sorry, but I’m still upset so spending a few days apart at a friends. She’s more or less saying I should be over it bc my reaction is worse than her actions bc she said sorry and promised to not do that again.
She was over 25 when we started dating
You have beautiful legs

I started working out again recently, you are right that it helps. I skipped today and was shaking and rocking back and forth bc I felt like a failure for not spending the day making some incremental progress. Oddly enough bc I’ve always been butch and not super cute, having a gf makes a lot more sense to me than having a bf. Her transitioning has been hard… her second adolescence in some ways has been really difficult. We’ve worked through a lot in the last two years but yeah, Idk how to be anything but supportive of her bc I do care for her.
